title: Hazel and the Tide
author: E. M. Sterling
blurb: Yara Halloran, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the last ferry of the season departs.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
